newsitem.title: CANADA: Cara shares heat up on strong Q3 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Cara shares heat up on strong Q3 earnings.

text.p: Food services firm Cara Operations Ltd topped Toronto's actives on Thursday, rising on positive third quarter results and strong second quarter numbers from 37-percent owned Second Cup Ltd.
"I think it's a combination of our business is growing and a return to profitability for Second Cup," said Cara president Gabe Tsampalieros.

Cara class A shares gained 0.35 to 4.10 on nearly 6.5 million shares while common shares rose 0.10 to 4.15 in light trading. Coffee house franchisor Second Cup stayed flat at 10.50 in very light dealings.

Cara's third quarter profit for the period ended December 8 rose to C$0.088 a share from year-ago C$0.073. Second Cup's second quarter December 14 results increased to C$0.21 a share from year-earlier C$0.19.
